info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Mortgage Loans Rates-v2-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loan Rates API provides access to the latest rates for various mortgage loan options. Users can retrieve up-to-date information on interest rates and terms for different types of loans. This API is essential for lenders, real estate professionals, and financial advisors who assist clients in making informed decisions regarding mortgage products. By integrating this API, developers can enhance applications that require real-time financial data, ensuring that users have access to the most current mortgage rate information.

get.summary: Retrieve the interest rate for loans.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the current loan interest rate available, providing essential information for potential borrowers to make informed decisions.
